# KBO: translation to the CPBL and a 2026 KBO foreign-player reference list (amendment 16; generated by `python -m src.kbo`)

Sources: FanGraphs KBO leaderboards 2015-2026 (cite "FanGraphs"); CPBL lines from the Baseball-Reference census (amendment 12, cite "Baseball-Reference"); AAA from the MLB Stats API (amendment 15 Marcel). Rules were committed before any KBO rate was computed. **The primary picks are unchanged**: KBO players are a separate reference list (Johnny chose 「另列參考」).

## Linking FanGraphs to MLBAM

Links by method: no register match 1236, fg key 258, name + birth year 255, birth date does not match 5, alias 1. Birth country comes from statsapi. Deviation D1 (decided before any result): the Chadwick register has no FanGraphs key for players who never reached the majors, so a FanGraphs player without one is linked by a unique name + birth-year match, accepted only when the statsapi birth date gives exactly FanGraphs' age (on 30 June) in every season listed (that convention matched 99.5% of FanGraphs-key links). One FanGraphs spelling the register cannot match was added by hand after the Baseball-Reference coverage check (`ALIASES` in src/kbo.py).

Coverage check against the Baseball-Reference register: 18 KBO -> CPBL pairs there, 18 in the sample. KBO BF on both sources for 79 pitcher-seasons: mean absolute difference 0.32 BF.

## 2026 KBO foreign players (reference list; not eligible for the primary pick)

Foreign = MLBAM-linked with a non-Korean statsapi birth country, >= 150 BF / >= 200 PA in KBO 2026. Exposure-qualified 2026 players without a link: 139; foreign ones among them (identified by hand from the name, listed in data/reference/kbo_unlinked_foreign_2026.csv, excluded): Keisho Shirakawa, Koki Sugimoto, Kanakubo Yuto, Yan-Cheng Wang, Shota Iimura. Deviation D2 (found in the availability news check, after the run): Kwon Ju (Joo Kwon, KT): born in China, plays as a domestic player - dropped.

`watchlist` = below the median of the qualified 2026 KBO foreign players of the same role (pitchers 2026 centred K-BB%, hitters 2026 centred wOBA): a performance-based non-renewal watchlist, not availability. `availability` comes from dated KBO / club announcements and news checked by hand on 2026-10-15 (data/reference/kbo_availability_2026.csv, one source URL per entry; namu.wiki and mykbostats were not reachable, so a late transaction could be missing). 'confirmed departure or release' here is mostly a mid-season 2026 release; a released player may have signed elsewhere since (Daz Cameron went back to AAA Buffalo), so it means 'left his KBO club', not 'unsigned'; 'unknown' means no 2027 decision was found. KBO reserve lists come out around 30 November, after the competition deadline.

Pitchers: projected CPBL centred K-BB% = T1 line (+0.0404 + 0.13 x KBO Marcel_c, forecast 2027 from KBO 2024-26). Percentile among the 57 AAA signable pitchers, whose projection is the census V3 line (+0.0263 + 0.99 x AAA Marcel_c). A baseline-only percentile (no Fit, no Stuff+). `extrapolated` = KBO Marcel outside the T1 training range (-0.032 to +0.053).

Read with care: the T1 point slope is 0.13, so every KBO pitcher's projection sits near the average of the KBO -> CPBL arrivals and the percentiles mostly say how that average compares with the AAA line, not how one KBO pitcher compares with another; slope 90% CI -0.79 to 1.14 (its sign is itself uncertain); in leave-one-out (K3) the line's error minus the plain mean's is +0.0037 (worse than the mean). The intervals are fitted-line intervals (both lines bootstrapped jointly by player, the candidates' Marcel values and the AAA pool held fixed); they leave out each player's own season-to-season noise, so a single pitcher's outcome is far less certain. AAA pitchers outside the census line's range: 0 of 57.
